# Instrument native engineering first observations

`first-observations.json` losslessly retains 38 original files, their modes and
SHA-256 identities. Commands, paths, proof sources and sketches are inert history;
the static reader never executes them or follows their recorded paths.

The API's first one-qubit source passed ordinary checking before the new native
flag existed. Its flag-only call returned usage failure; the separate native
call with a product version fell through the old CLI and returned an I/O error.
The first `compare-instrument` call returned the old pure-command usage diagnostic.
These are actual before diagnostics, not successful instrument verification.

Four first mathematical study sources retain their first compilation attempts
and actual stdout/stderr: three failures and an initially successful feed-forward
study. The initial pure study failed outside Lean's
package root; other first attempts and the separate production namespace error
remain visible. Harness/elaboration failures are not semantic rejections or
proof evidence. Current maintained modules and fresh validation are separate.

Later CLI checks submit immutable original graph data through newly authored
fixed requests/commands, including nonzero/tight/zero budgets and residual/reference
coherence counterexamples. They do not replay recorded history, establish source
lowering, recover pure phase/control access or certify target resources.
